summary: Available August 2024 · West Jesmond Location · Six Double Bedrooms
description:
My Property Box are delighted to market this modern six bedroom student property, available to rent from August 2024. This spacious maisonette is located on the ever popular Bayswater Road, West Jesmond.

Comprising of; stairs to the first floor, communal living room, large galley kitchen, six double bedrooms and two shared bathrooms. The property is finished to a very high standard throughout. Situated in the heart of West Jesmond, Bayswater Road is one of Jesmond's most popular student streets due to it's close proximity to local amenities, West Jesmond Metro station and the infamous Lonsdale pub. Properties in this area are always in high demand so get in touch to arrange a viewing today.
